matched_betting.offer: Bet £10, get £30 Sports Free Bets + £20 Bet Builder Free Bets (new customers only)
matched_betting.book: Betfred (UK licensed, not part of Flutter/Entain/Evoke)
steps: Only do this if you have NEVER had a Betfred account. Please tell me which bookies you already have accounts with.
You need a Betfair Exchange account with about £90 in it (£27 for step 4 + £58 for step 7). Both bets are placed by you; I never place anything.
Join Betfred and deposit £10 with a debit card (the T&Cs say there are payment exclusions, so use a debit card, not PayPal or Skrill).

QUALIFYING BET: back £10 at evens (2.0) or bigger at Betfred. Example: Brentford v Everton DRAW @ 3.6. On Betfair, LAY the same draw: £9.86 at 3.7 (liability £26.63). Either way you lose about £0.63. Use the real prices at the time with the calculator.
The bet must settle within 7 days. The free bets arrive within 24 hours of settlement and expire after 7 days.
FREE BET (£30 sports): back a selection at odds of about 3.5-5 with the free bet (stake not returned), and lay it on Betfair.
Example: free bet at 3.6, lay £21.37 at 3.7 (liability £57.70), and you keep about £20.30 whatever happens. At 5.0/5.2 you keep about £22.14 but the liability is £97.86.
The £20 Bet Builder free bets can't be laid cleanly. Treat them as fun-pot bets, not locked profit.
Calculator: python3 matched_bet_calc.py --mode snr --stake 30 --back X --lay Y --commission 0.05 (or I'll run it for you). Re-check both prices just before you place.
